about: SNOOZY, who keeps the pumps going in the pump room behind the prisoner tunnel (plans/tunnel.gd). Placeholder lines written on 2026-11-15 by the civic worker, not the owners' wording. Format: see scripts/talk_box.gd.

fix.speaker: npc
fix.line: Same leak as last year. It moves, I follow it.

pipes.speaker: npc
pipes.line: Heat for the court, water for the cells. Nobody comes back here but me.

out.speaker: npc
out.line: Through the post, if the officer's in a good mood.
